messages:
Ivy (marketing): Need a tiny battlecard for sales + webinar landing. Two micro-hooks: 'Cost predict' and 'Ops guardrails'. 2 bullets each + 1 rebut line. Keep it tweet-length.
Jay (growth): Lead with a dollar stat for cost. People latch on. Also propose two CTAs to AB test: 'Estimate your token bill' vs 'See latency tail'.
Kali (product): Bench snapshot: cached chat = $0.25/1k tokens; uncached ~ $0.60. Variant fallback improved success rate ~3x in stress tests. I'll drop the bench link after this.
hubspot-bot: Bench CSV available: https://redwood.internal/bench/1890 (internal)
Leo (sales): Rebuttal lines: "Why not just cloud serverless?" -> "Serverless can spike costs and latency; Dedicated gives predictable invoices and SLA-backed throughput." Short and punchy.
Mira (content): I'll make two email subjects per hook and 3 short LinkedIn blurbs. Examples: 'Pin your token spend' and 'Stop tail latency from breaking UX'. Need final bullets by 3pm.
Ivy (marketing): Draft bullets below, please tweak: ```
Cost predictability:
- $0.25 / 1k tokens with prefix caching vs ~$0.60 uncached (bench)
- Committed Dedicated pricing + Optimize reduces surprise spend
- Rebuttal: "Hidden fees?" -> "Console shows token-level charges so nothing is hidden."

Ops guardrails:
- Dedicated SLA cuts 99p latency jitter ~3x during congestion (bench)
- Smart routing + variant fallback keeps success rate high under regional pressure
- Rebuttal: "Vendor lock-in?" -> "Model catalog + rollout controls keep models portable across deployments."
```
Jay (growth): Swap cost bullets to lead with the dollar figure (price first). I'll set up CTA AB test and track bench-click, demo-request, webinar-attend.
Leo (sales): I'll post two 1-line outreach opens after lunch (cost-first and ops-first).
Ivy (marketing): Action items: Kali paste CSV link (by noon); Mira draft subjects + blurbs (by 3pm); Jay wire AB test; Leo draft outreach. I'll stitch a one-pager and post in #docs when ready. :rocket:
